name: Systematic Debugging
description: Reproduce failures, isolate root causes, and verify fixes instead of guessing.
instructions: Do not guess or make speculative edits. Reproduce the failure and capture the exact error. Trace the failing behavior to its earliest incorrect assumption or state. Form a testable hypothesis, change one cause at a time, and rerun the reproduction. Add a regression test where practical. Verify the fix and check for nearby regressions.
